title: Wso2am: By default, StaxUtils placed no limit on the total number of elements or the total number of characters in an…
description: A security vulnerability in the wso2am package arises because StaxUtils, by default, imposes no limit on the total number of elements or characters in an XML document. This flaw can lead to a denial of service condition due to resource exhaustion. The vulnerability affects versions prior to 4.7.0-r4 and has been assigned a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.5. A fix is available in version 4.7.0-r4.
